findings.summary: Imports use .ts extension under NodeNext+verbatimModuleSyntax; tsc -b will emit TS5097 (biome misses this).
findings.suggested_fix: Change `from '../../src/db/client.ts'` to `'../../src/db/client.js'`, and likewise for schema.ts on line 9. Sprint-001 convention is .js extensions for ESM NodeNext imports.

findings.summary: Four imports use .ts extensions (Db, defaultPasswordHasher, user, SEED_PLAINTEXT) — TS5097 under NodeNext.
stopPostgresContainer always calls container.stop(), defeating withReuse() on local re-runs (CI-side is fine).
findings.suggested_fix: Gate `await container.stop()` on `process.env.CI === 'true'` or expose a noStop flag; otherwise the reuse path adds zero value and per-file teardown is the per-wave flake source noted in retro.

findings.summary: repo.ts imports the eager db singleton from ../../db/client.js; functions take no db arg, blocking DI for unit tests / buildApp wiring.
findings.suggested_fix: Either (a) accept `db: Db` as a parameter on each repo function, or (b) export a `createAuthRepo(db: Db)` factory consumed by createAuthService — aligns with the DI factory pattern used by createAuthService/buildApp downstream.

findings.summary: insertUser parameter typed as `role: string`; weaker than the schema's CHECK constraint ('patient'|'doctor').
findings.suggested_fix: Tighten to `role: 'patient' | 'doctor'` (or import a Role type from schema.ts). Keeps the seed/test callers honest at compile time.

findings.summary: `void pool.end()` fire-and-forget in finally; uncaught rejection from pool.end is swallowed.
findings.suggested_fix: Either `await pool.end()` (the finally can be `async`) or `.catch(err => logger.error({err}, 'pool.end failed'))` to surface drain failures.

findings.summary: notContainsAny signature is (needles) rather than the planner-described (lines, needles); consumers already use the implemented shape.
findings.suggested_fix: No code change required; flag for retro to update the task-test-support description so future planner runs match the as-built API.
